verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a built-in AI agent ("Neo") that lets users delegate infra tasks in plain English, and ships an official MCP server (confirmed working via a live handshake probe) that can delegate tasks to Neo or other AI coding assistants. However, Neo itself is only described in marketing docs with no hands-on or community validation, and separate community feedback flags Pulumi's genAI-based documentation/assistant quality as poor, so the actual delegated-task experience is unproven.
